seo_title: ماونتن فيو آي سيتي أكتوبر 2026 — الأسعار وأنظمة السداد
seo_description: دليل Mountain View iCity October 2026: مشروع 500 فدان في أكتوبر بجزر وكباري، أسعار الشقق والآي فيلا واللاك هاوس من Tycoons، مقدم 3% وتقسيط لحد 12 سنة.

article_sections.heading: آي سيتي أكتوبر في سطور
paragraphs: Mountain View iCity October مشروع من Mountain View في 6 أكتوبر على مساحة حوالي 500 فدان. فكرته جزر سكنية بينها مسطحات خضرا وكباري للمشاة، وأغلب الوحدات بتطل على لاند سكيب أو بحيرات.
المطور سلّم أجزاء من المشروع زي Club Park، وفيه مراحل تانية زي Lagoon Beach Park ميعاد تسليمها حوالي 2030.
عندنا في Tycoons وقت كتابة الصفحة (أكتوبر 2026) وحدات متاحة في آي سيتي أكتوبر بأسعار بتبدأ من {{min_price}} جنيه.

article_sections.heading: الموقع
paragraphs: المشروع قريب من محور دهشور (حوالي 4 كم)، ومول العرب حوالي 6 كم، ومحور 26 يوليو حوالي 7 كم. ده بيخليه قريب من الشيخ زايد ووسط أكتوبر، مع إن العنوان الرسمي أكتوبر.

article_sections.heading: أنواع الوحدات والأسعار 2026
paragraphs: الأرقام دي من الوحدات المتاحة عندنا في أكتوبر 2026، وهي أسعار بداية بالتقسيط:
شقة Millennial حوالي 115 متر بحوالي 12.8 مليون، وI-Apartment حوالي 155 متر بحوالي 11.3 مليون، وGarden Millennial حوالي 165 متر بحوالي 17.2 مليون، وSky Loft حوالي 260 متر بحوالي 17.1 مليون.

الآي فيلا من حوالي 17.1 مليون (190 متر) لحد حوالي 23.8 مليون (240 متر)، وPark Villa حوالي 175 متر بحوالي 17.5 مليون، وBeach House حوالي 210 متر بحوالي 25.2 مليون، وLake House حوالي 385 متر بحوالي 63.2 مليون.
في نص الوحدات المتاحة عندنا سعر المتر حوالي 100 ألف جنيه، وده قريب من متوسط أكتوبر عندنا (حوالي 110 ألف). الشقق الكبيرة والسكاي لوفت سعر مترها أقل، واللاك هاوس أعلى بكتير بسبب الإطلالة.

article_sections.heading: أنظمة السداد والاستلام
paragraphs: المقدم من 3% وتقسيط لحد 12 سنة، والاستلام للوحدات المتاحة عندنا حوالي 3 سنين. النظام بيختلف حسب المرحلة وميعاد الاستلام، فلازم تتأكد من الجدول الكامل قبل الحجز.
مع مقدم 3%، خد بالك من الدفعات اللي بعده في أول سنة، ومن وديعة الصيانة اللي بتتدفع قبل الاستلام.

article_sections.heading: آي سيتي أكتوبر تناسب مين؟
paragraphs: للعيلة اللي عايزة آي فيلا أو شقة بجنينة في غرب القاهرة بمقدم صغير، وللي شغله في زايد أو أكتوبر. ولو بتقارن، شوف دليل الشيخ زايد وأكتوبر ومشاريع ماونتن فيو التانية زي آي سيتي القاهرة الجديدة.

faq.answer: في الوحدات المتاحة عندنا من حوالي 11.3 مليون لشقة 155 متر لحد حوالي 63.2 مليون للاك هاوس 385 متر. السعر النهائي بيتأكد مع المطور.

en.seo_title: Mountain View iCity October 2026 — Prices & Payment Plans
en.seo_description: Mountain View iCity October 2026: a 500-feddan community in 6th of October with islands and bridges. Apartment, iVilla and Lake House prices, 3% down, up to 12 years.

content.text: Mountain View iCity October is a Mountain View community of about 500 feddans in 6th of October City. It is planned as residential islands separated by green spaces and lakes and linked by pedestrian bridges, so most homes look onto landscape or water.
Parts of the project such as Club Park have been delivered, while later phases such as Lagoon Beach Park are scheduled for around 2030.
Location: about 4 km from the Dahshur Link, 6 km from Mall of Arabia and 7 km from the 26th of July Corridor, which keeps Sheikh Zayed and central October close.

These are starting instalment prices from the units we had available in October 2026. Apartments: Millennial around 115 m² at about EGP 12.8M, I-Apartment around 155 m² at about EGP 11.3M, Garden Millennial around 165 m² at about EGP 17.2M and Sky Loft around 260 m² at about EGP 17.1M.
Houses: iVillas from about EGP 17.1M (190 m²) to EGP 23.8M (240 m²), Park Villa around 175 m² at EGP 17.5M, Beach House around 210 m² at EGP 25.2M and Lake House around 385 m² at EGP 63.2M.

The median price per m² across our available units is about EGP 100K, close to our October average of about EGP 110K. Larger apartments and Sky Lofts come in lower per metre; Lake Houses are far higher because of the view.

Down payments start at 3% with instalments up to 12 years, and delivery for our available units is about 3 years. Plans change by phase, so confirm the full schedule before booking, including the payments in the first year and the maintenance deposit due before handover.

It suits families who want an iVilla or a garden apartment west of Cairo with a small down payment, and buyers who work in Sheikh Zayed or October. Compare it with our Sheikh Zayed and October guide and with Mountain View iCity New Cairo.

faq.question: Where is Mountain View iCity October?
faq.answer: In 6th of October City, near the Dahshur Link, Mall of Arabia and the 26th of July Corridor.

faq.question: How much are Mountain View iCity October prices in 2026?
faq.answer: Our available units run from about EGP 11.3M for a 155 m² apartment to about EGP 63.2M for a 385 m² Lake House. Final prices are confirmed with the developer.

faq.question: What is the payment plan?
faq.answer: From 3% down with instalments up to 12 years on our available units.

faq.question: When is delivery?
faq.answer: About 3 years for our available units; parts of the community such as Club Park are already delivered.

faq.question: What is the price per square metre?
faq.answer: About EGP 100K at the median of our available units, close to the October average.

seo_description: دليل LifeWise من EONS على طريق السويس 2026: 29 فدان سكني وتجاري، شقق ودوبلكس وعيادات ومكاتب من Tycoons، مقدم 5% + 5% بعد 3 شهور على 10 سنين.

article_sections.heading: لايف وايز في سطور

المشروع ليه واجهة حوالي 370 متر على طريق السويس، والمطور بيقول إن حوالي 80% من مساحته مسطحات خضرا ومفتوحة.
عندنا في Tycoons وقت كتابة الصفحة (أكتوبر 2026) وحدات متاحة في لايف وايز بأسعار بتبدأ من {{min_price}} جنيه.

article_sections.heading: الوحدات
paragraphs: الشقق السكنية من حوالي 85 لـ 265 متر، وفيه دوبلكس حوالي 224 متر. والجزء التجاري فيه عيادات من حوالي 50 لـ 181 متر، ومكاتب من حوالي 70 لـ 185 متر.

article_sections.heading: الأسعار 2026
paragraphs: الأرقام دي من الوحدات المسجلة عندنا في أكتوبر 2026: الشقق من حوالي 3.6 مليون (85 متر) لحد حوالي 7.1 مليون (170 متر)، والدوبلكس 224 متر بحوالي 10.9 مليون.
العيادات من حوالي 4.8 مليون لحد 20.3 مليون، والمكاتب من حوالي 5.6 مليون لحد 17.3 مليون حسب المساحة.
أسعار الشقق المسجلة عندنا أقل بكتير من متوسط القاهرة الجديدة، فلازم تتأكد من السعر الحالي والمرحلة مع المطور قبل ما تبني قرارك عليها.

article_sections.heading: أنظمة السداد والاستلام
paragraphs: المقدم 5% وبعده 5% كمان بعد 3 شهور، والباقي على 10 سنين. الاستلام حوالي 4 سنين من التعاقد.
يعني فعليًا محتاج حوالي 10% من سعر الوحدة في أول 3 شهور، وده رقم مهم تحسبه قبل الحجز.

article_sections.heading: لايف وايز تناسب مين؟
paragraphs: للي عايز شقة أو عيادة أو مكتب في مشروع واحد على طريق السويس، وللمستثمر اللي بيدور على وحدة إدارية أو طبية بتقسيط طويل. قارنه بمشاريع مستقبل سيتي اللي قريبة منه في دليل مستقبل سيتي.

en.seo_title: LifeWise EONS Suez Road 2026 — Prices & Payment Plan
en.seo_description: LifeWise by EONS on Suez Road, New Cairo, 2026: 29 feddans of homes, clinics and offices. Prices and sizes, 5% down plus 5% after 3 months, 10 years.

content.text: LifeWise is an EONS Developments project of about 29 feddans on Suez Road in New Cairo. Roughly half is residential and half is commercial, administrative and medical, and the developer puts total investment above EGP 10 billion.
The project has about 370 metres of frontage on Suez Road, and the developer says around 80% of the land is green or open space.
Homes range from about 85 to 265 m², with duplexes around 224 m². The commercial side has clinics from about 50 to 181 m² and offices from about 70 to 185 m².

From the units listed with us in October 2026: apartments from about EGP 3.6M (85 m²) to EGP 7.1M (170 m²), a 224 m² duplex at about EGP 10.9M, clinics from EGP 4.8M to 20.3M and offices from EGP 5.6M to 17.3M.
The listed apartment prices are well below the New Cairo average, so confirm the current price and phase with the developer before relying on them.

The plan is 5% down plus another 5% after three months, with the balance over 10 years. Delivery is about four years from contract, which means you need around 10% of the price in the first three months.

LifeWise suits buyers who want a home, clinic or office in one project on Suez Road, and investors looking for medical or office space on a long plan. Compare it with nearby projects in our Mostakbal City guide.

faq.question: Where is LifeWise?
faq.answer: On Suez Road in New Cairo, with about 370 metres of road frontage.

faq.question: How much are LifeWise prices in 2026?
faq.answer: Listed apartments run from about EGP 3.6M to 7.1M and clinics and offices start from about EGP 4.8M. Current prices are confirmed with the developer.

faq.question: What is the payment plan?
faq.answer: 5% down, 5% after three months and the rest over 10 years.

faq.question: Are there commercial units?
faq.answer: Yes, clinics and offices; about half of the project is commercial, administrative and medical.

faq.question: When is delivery?
faq.answer: About four years from contract.

en.seo_title: Begonia Residence Menassat New Cairo 2026 — Prices
en.seo_description: Begonia Residence by Menassat, 2026: a 26-feddan compound in South Investors, New Cairo. Apartment prices from Tycoons, 10% down over 10 years, delivery 2030.

content.text: Begonia Residence is a residential compound by Menassat Developments in the South Investors area (South Academy) of New Cairo. It covers about 26 feddans, and the developer puts investment at around EGP 10 billion.
It sits between the Gamal Abdel Nasser and Mohamed Naguib axes, close to North 90th Street, the American University in Cairo and the Fifth Settlement banking district.
From the units we had available in October 2026: an apartment of about 56 m² at about EGP 6.5M on instalments.
That works out at about EGP 116K per m², in line with our New Cairo average. Larger layouts and ground floors with gardens are priced differently, so ask for the full list.

The plan is 10% down with instalments over 10 years, and expected delivery is around January 2030. Before booking, ask about the handover payment, the maintenance deposit and whether a larger down payment earns a discount.

It suits buyers who want a small or mid-size apartment south of the Academy near North 90th Street, and investors after a compact unit that is easy to rent in New Cairo. Compare it with Begonia Walk, the same developer's commercial project, and with our New Cairo guide.

en.seo_title: Grand Valleys Mountain View 2026 — Villa Prices & Plans
en.seo_description: Grand Valleys by Mountain View, 2026: a villas-only community of about 500 feddans near South 90th Street, New Cairo. Villa prices, 3% down, up to 12 years.

content.text: Grand Valleys is a Mountain View project developed with STM on about 500 feddans in New Cairo, near South 90th Street. It was launched in April 2025.
The community is laid out as about 15 valleys, the developer says around 93% of the land is open space, and every home is a villa.
From the units we had available in October 2026: a Grand View villa of about 250 m² at about EGP 30.5M on instalments.
That is about EGP 122K per m², a little above our New Cairo average of about EGP 116K, which is normal for a standalone villa in a low-density community.

Our available villa comes with 3% down and instalments up to 12 years, with delivery in about two years depending on phase. Other plans use a fixed down payment (roughly EGP 800K to 2M) over a shorter term, so compare the payments in the first two years.
It suits families who want a standalone villa in an all-villa community with a lot of open space and a small down payment. Compare it with our New Cairo guide and other Mountain View projects.

faq.question: Where is Grand Valleys?
faq.answer: In New Cairo near South 90th Street, on about 500 feddans.

faq.question: How much are Grand Valleys prices in 2026?
faq.answer: We have a villa of about 250 m² at about EGP 30.5M on instalments. Final prices are confirmed with the developer.

faq.question: Are there apartments?
faq.answer: No, the project is villas only.

faq.question: What is the payment plan?
faq.answer: 3% down with up to 12 years on our available villa, plus fixed down-payment plans.

faq.question: Who is the developer?

en.seo_title: The Mornings Al Ahly Sabbour New Cairo 2026 — Prices
en.seo_description: The Mornings by Al Ahly Sabbour, 2026: a 15-feddan compound in El Yasmeen, Fifth Settlement. Apartments 57–148 m², 5% down, instalments up to 14 years.

content.text: The Mornings is a residential compound by Al Ahly Sabbour on about 15 feddans in El Yasmeen, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo.
It sits near the Sadat Axis and North 90th Street, close to the American University in Cairo and the banking district.
From the units we had available in October 2026: apartments from about 57 m² at EGP 5.4M up to about 148 m² at EGP 13M on instalments.
The median price per m² is about EGP 91K, roughly 20% below our New Cairo average of about EGP 116K, which makes it one of the more affordable options inside the Fifth Settlement.

Down payments start at 5% with instalments up to 14 years on our available units, and delivery is about four years. Other plans take 10% or 15% down over shorter terms, often with a discount, so compare the total price rather than only the monthly instalment.
It suits first-time buyers who want a Fifth Settlement apartment below the average price per metre on a long plan, and investors after a small rental unit. Compare it in our New Cairo guide.

faq.question: Where is The Mornings?
faq.answer: In El Yasmeen, Fifth Settlement, near the Sadat Axis and North 90th Street.

faq.question: How much are The Mornings prices in 2026?
faq.answer: Available apartments run from about EGP 5.4M (57 m²) to EGP 13M (148 m²). Final prices are confirmed with the developer.

faq.question: What is the payment plan?
faq.answer: From 5% down with up to 14 years, plus plans with a higher down payment and a shorter term.

faq.question: What is the price per square metre?
faq.answer: About EGP 91K at the median of our available units, around 20% below the New Cairo average.

faq.question: When is delivery?
faq.answer: About four years from contract.

paragraphs: Olin Social District مشروع تجاري وإداري وطبي من Mass Developments في القاهرة الجديدة، على محور جمال عبد الناصر. المطور بيقول إن المنطقة اللي حواليه فيها حوالي 350 ألف ساكن، وده جمهور المحلات والعيادات.

paragraphs: الأرقام دي من الوحدات المتاحة عندنا في أكتوبر 2026، بالتقسيط: عيادة حوالي 30 متر بحوالي 4.8 مليون، ومكتب حوالي 31 متر بحوالي 5.1 مليون، ومحل حوالي 27 متر بحوالي 8.1 مليون.

في الوحدات التجارية اسأل كمان عن رسوم الإدارة والتشغيل بعد الاستلام، وعن إذا كان المطور بيدير التأجير.

en.seo_title: Olin Mall Mass Developments New Cairo 2026 — Prices
en.seo_description: Olin Social District by Mass Developments, 2026: retail, clinics and offices on the Gamal Abdel Nasser Axis, New Cairo. Unit prices, 7% or 10% down, up to 10 years.

content.text: Olin Social District is a retail, office and medical project by Mass Developments on the Gamal Abdel Nasser Axis in New Cairo. The developer says the surrounding area has around 350,000 residents, the catchment for its shops and clinics.
From the units we had available in October 2026, on instalments: a clinic of about 30 m² at EGP 4.8M, an office of about 31 m² at EGP 5.1M and a shop of about 27 m² at EGP 8.1M.

That is about EGP 300K per m² for retail and about EGP 160K for clinics and offices. Shops always cost more per metre because they rent for more, so compare on expected net yield rather than price per metre alone.

The down payment is 7% or 10% with instalments up to 10 years depending on the unit, and delivery is about three and a half years. For commercial units, also ask about management and operating fees after handover and whether the developer runs leasing.
It suits investors who want a small shop, clinic or office in New Cairo for under EGP 10M on a long plan. Read our guide to real estate investment in Egypt to work out net yield first.

faq.question: Where is Olin?
faq.answer: On the Gamal Abdel Nasser Axis in New Cairo.

faq.question: How much are shops in Olin?
faq.answer: We have a 27 m² shop at about EGP 8.1M, a 30 m² clinic at EGP 4.8M and a 31 m² office at EGP 5.1M. Prices are confirmed with the developer.

faq.question: What is the payment plan?
faq.answer: 7% or 10% down with up to 10 years.

faq.question: When is delivery?
faq.answer: About three and a half years from contract.

faq.question: Is the rental return guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Any yield is an estimate; work out the net figure after operating fees and taxes.
